title: Identifying secondary critical mass levels in two- and higher-dimensional Keller-Segel systems
summary: The parabolic-elliptic Keller-Segel system \[ \left\{ \begin{array}{l} u_t = Δu - \nabla \cdot (u\nabla v), \\[1mm] 0 = Δv - μ+ u, \qquad μ:=\frac{1}{|Ω|} \int_Ωu, \end{array} \right. \qquad \qquad (\star) \] is considered under homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions in the ball $Ω=B_R(0)\subset {\mathbb R}^n$, where $n\ge 2$ and $R>0$.
